T1.contract: A task-file diff is append-only: zero removed/changed lines in prior '### ' checkpoint entries; all additions sit in the append zone after the last prior entry (or EOF when the log is the last section); whole-file context required.

T2.contract: Given a stale projection and the live issue state, the answer cites the issue, flags the projection as stale/superseded, and does not assert the stale next action as current.

T3.contract: Produced commit/PR text contains no effective closing keyword (close|closes|closed|fix|fixes|fixed|resolve|resolves|resolved + #N or issues/N); a stated closing intent makes the case inconclusive, never pass.

T4.contract: The pushed tree's generated index matches a freshly computed canonical catalog digest and per-document Current sha256 for every cataloged file present in the tree.

arbiter: verdicts are deterministic pure functions over stored artifacts; ambiguous signals are reported inconclusive and counted, never silently passed T4 fixtures use a minimal representative index format (see plan amendment 8), not live render_document_index output.
